aria-label.description:
Accessible name of an icon-only option. An enabled icon-only option also
shows this name on focus and hover when ki-tooltip is registered. The
all-elements loader includes it. For a text option, use the visible label.

disabled.description: Excludes the option from selection and keyboard navigation.

value.description: Required nonempty option identifier. Each value must be unique in its group.

--ki-density-control-offset.description: Added to the block size of every scaled control and row (button, icon button, field, select, textarea, option, list item, tab). Components floor the result at ki.size.target-min.

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-segment-font-size.description: Text size of medium and small segments.

--ki-segment-gap.description: Gap between the leading icon and label.

--ki-segment-line-height.description: Line height of medium and small segments.

--ki-segment-padding-inline.description: Inline padding of a medium or small segment.

--ki-segmented-control-track-size-md.description: Medium track height before density adjustment.

--ki-segmented-item-backdrop-filter.description: Complete CSS backdrop filter behind an unselected segment.

--ki-segmented-item-bg.description: Resting surface of an unselected segment, matching the track by default.

--ki-segmented-item-bg-image.description: Optional image layered over an unselected segment surface.

--ki-segmented-item-fg.description: Resting ink of an unselected segment, strengthened in contrast-more.

--ki-segmented-selected-backdrop-filter.description: Complete CSS backdrop filter behind the selected segment.

--ki-segmented-selected-bg.description: Raised selected surface, lighter than the track in both schemes.

--ki-segmented-selected-bg-image.description: Optional image layered over the selected segment.

--ki-segmented-selected-border-color.description: High-contrast selection boundary when elevation or surface differences are subtle.

--ki-segmented-track-padding.description: Inset between the track and its segments.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

component.description: A single choice in a ki-segmented-control.

button.description: The native option surface with radio semantics.

slots.description:
Noninteractive visible option label. A label wider than its share of
the row wraps onto a second line and every option of the row keeps one
height; text that would need a third line ends with an ellipsis, and the
full text stays the option's accessible name. Keep it to a few words.

start.description: Decorative leading icon. Supply aria-label for an icon-only option.
